﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: jcabi-aspects 0.24.1 -> 0.25.1

## Context

Project `jcabi-ssh` (by jcabi) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`com.jcabi:jcabi-aspects` from `0.24.1` to `0.25.1` (minor update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/jcabi/jcabi-ssh/pull/148

## Your Task

The source code is in `/jcabi-ssh`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.

- `Tv.TEN` = `10`
